claim_boundary: Automatic four-second double-light clip intervals with left, right, or together scoreboard-delta labels. These labels are not verified referee decisions, right-of-way calls, touch correctness, or weapon labels. YouTube media are not downloaded or redistributed. Every one of the upstream validation videos also appears in its train split, so the published split is rejected and any future model must hold out complete source-video groups. The source has no license. Overlapping source videos with the Fencing Matches AI archive are identified and never counted as independent videos.
